test.detail: 381 test files passed, 3682 tests total, 0 failures, 28 skipped

typecheck.detail: Pre-existing TS2322 in FactoryDroidByokSiteCard.tsx:105 fixed during scrutiny (added ReasoningLevel cast). Zero errors after fix.

lint.detail: 0 errors, 1448 pre-existing warnings. No new issues.

findings.description: Redundant `visible` prop on AllowedToolsSelector — parent already guards with isDroidBackend condition, so the internal `if (!visible) return null` guard is dead code.
Catch block reuses allowedToolsUnsupported i18n key for transport errors. Consider a separate key for IPC failures vs backend-unsupported.
resolveToolIds pure function wrapped in useCallback with [] deps — extract as module-level function to avoid hook overhead.

features.summary: Clean 3-state tool whitelist UI with correct null/[]/[ids] semantics. i18n complete. 18 tests covering DOM, backend guard, and integration. No blocking issues.

findings.description: addMcpServer/authenticateMcpServer use Record<string, unknown> for params, losing type safety at IPC boundary. SDK will reject invalid params but no runtime validation at bridge level.
Agent reference captured before entering mutex lock could be stale during session rebuild. Theoretical only — session rebuilds don't occur during MCP operations.
Lock map uses Promise<unknown> instead of Promise<void> for semantic clarity.

features.summary: Solid IPC quartet implementation for all 6 MCP methods. Backend guards never throw, mutex is correct with no deadlock risk, 47 tests cover all 4 axes. No blocking issues.

findings.description: Greedy mcp_auth success handler flips ALL needsLogin entries when any server completes OAuth. The handler iterates all oauthStatus entries and marks every one with needsLogin===true as authenticated, ignoring payload.serverName. Bug only manifests with multiple simultaneous OAuth-requiring MCP servers.
findings.suggestedFix: Store server name alongside status so handler can match payload.serverName to the correct entry.

findings.description: refreshFromLiveSession error path uses raw backend error string via Message.warning instead of the defined i18n key mcpIpcListFailed.
Backend bridge drops authUrl from SDK response (known issue from handoff). Users never see OAuth page opened automatically.

features.summary: IPC wiring for add/remove/toggle is correct with proper error handling. 14 DOM tests comprehensive. Main concern: greedy mcp_auth handler incorrectly authenticates all pending servers when any one completes. Secondary: raw error strings bypass i18n.

findings.description: JSDoc claims regex matches it.only/it.skip — incorrect, the regex `\bit\s*\(` won't match those forms.
IPC_SYMBOLS is hardcoded — no mechanism to detect drift if new IPC methods are added.

features.summary: Solid meta-test. All 3 invariants (VAL-IPC-016/017/018) correctly asserted. 7/7 IPC symbols confirmed in renderer, 87 test cases above threshold, zero cross-process boundary violations. Only cosmetic issues.

concerns.description: Greedy mcp_auth handler in useMcpOAuth.ts marks all OAuth-pending servers as authenticated when any single server completes OAuth. Low risk for single-server flows (common case) but incorrect for multi-server scenarios.
concerns.suggestedFix: Match payload.serverName to specific server entry instead of broadcasting to all needsLogin entries.

typecheckFix.description: Added `as ReasoningLevel[]` cast to the `['none']` literal in fallback map and imported ReasoningLevel type. Fixes pre-existing TS2322 error that all 4 feature workers noted but didn't fix.

recommendation: Milestone m4-ipc-exposure passes scrutiny with one major concern (greedy OAuth handler). The concern is non-blocking for single-server flows but should be tracked for fix in a future milestone. All validators green, code quality is high, test coverage is thorough.
